title: Junior Hicks' files on Uinta Basin UFO sightings since 1950

tellings.quote: And Junior Hicks had detailed files going back to 1950 documenting hundreds of UFO sightings

plain: A local man named Junior Hicks kept detailed files on hundreds of UFO sightings in Utah's Uinta Basin, going back to 1950. Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in that basin known for strange reports, passes this on, along with the names of Thomas Winterton, a witness, and Jim Morse, and a book called The Utah UFO Display. He tells it to show that the area's strange activity goes back decades.
